name: Asel Keyes
role: Partner in Keyes & Bramble, Black Hills freight forwarders
bio: Asel Keyes was a partner in Keyes & Bramble, the forwarding firm offered the job of forwarders for Black Hills freight via Medora by the Black Hills Shippers' Association in April 1884, after he had traveled over the Medora route with Pennell and the editor in March. In May 1884 the firm's office furniture arrived in Medora and he was described as one of the Northern Pacific forwarding company that controlled the new freight route.
